endorsements.quote: Implement consent-linked metadata, provenance tracking, and interoperable removal protocols across platforms

unlisted_practices: Retain verifiable publication consent documentation for clinical images long-term.
Separate publication consent from treatment consent for clinical images.
Verify consent documentation before republication, digitization, or digital redistribution of clinical images.
Conduct periodic institutional review of legacy educational archives containing clinical images.
Establish coordinated cross-platform withdrawal procedures among health care institutions, publishers, universities, libraries, repositories, and digital platforms.
Document the scope and duration of reuse permissions for clinical images.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/framework paper analyzing governance gaps and proposing a lifecycle-oriented governance framework for pediatric clinical image reuse and downstream AI integration.
